Accessibility

Mr & Mrs Outdoor Living is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for all users, including individuals with disabilities.

Our Commitment

We strive to make our website accessible and user-friendly by following generally recognized accessibility standards and best practices.

Ongoing Efforts

We are continuously working to improve the accessibility of our website, including:

  • Clear navigation and readable content
  • Proper color contrast and typography
  • Compatibility with screen readers and assistive technologies

Limitations

While we aim to ensure accessibility across all areas of the website, some content or features may not yet be fully optimized. We appreciate your patience as we continue to improve.

Feedback & Assistance

If you experience any difficulty accessing content on our website or have suggestions for improvement, please contact us:

📧 info@mrandmrsoutdoorliving.com
📞 North Florida: +1 (352) 740-3361
📞 South Florida: +1 (954) 913-7112

We will make reasonable efforts to address accessibility concerns promptly.

Privacy Policy

Mr & Mrs Outdoor Living values your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.

Information We Collect

We may collect personal information when you:

  • Fill out a contact or estimate form
  • Schedule a consultation
  • Contact us via email or phone

This information may include your name, email address, phone number, project details, and location.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Respond to inquiries and requests
  • Provide estimates and consultations
  • Improve our services and website experience
  • Communicate about your project or services requested

Information Sharing

We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties, except when required to provide services or comply with legal obligations.

Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

Cookies

Our website may use cookies or similar technologies to improve functionality and user experience. You can adjust your browser settings to decline cookies if you prefer.

Your Rights

You may request access, correction, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us directly.

Updates to This Policy

This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page.
